subject: general
question: Fill in the blank marked [C] using the most appropriate option.
solution:
The correct answer is '**an**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank [C] is followed by the word "old," which starts with a vowel sound.
 
• In English grammar, the article "**an**" is used before words beginning with a vowel sound.
 
• "**An old cottage**" is the correct phrase, as "old" starts with a vowel sound (o).
 
• Other options do not fit grammatically: 
 
 
• "**No article**" would make the sentence incorrect.
 
• "**A old cottage**" is incorrect because "a" is used before consonant sounds.
 
• "**The old cottage**" would imply a specific cottage already known to the children, but this is their first encounter with it.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "A" is used before words beginning with consonant sounds, e.g., "a book, a car."
 
• "An" is used before words beginning with vowel sounds, e.g., "an apple, an hour, an old man."
 
• "The" is used when referring to something specific or previously mentioned.
